title: Sea View at at Compass Point II Vacation Rental
h1: Sea View at at Compass Point II
meta_description: Sea View at at Compass Point II is a 3.00 bedroom, 3.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Description PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:- Gulf Views and Pool Views From The Balcony- Access To Three Community Pools (Compass, Dunesider Pool, Bridges Pool within the Bridges Gate)- Steps To The Compass Pool And Dunesider Community Pool - 4 Adult Bikes Included In Rental- 4 Seater Electric Cart for Guest Use Within The Neighborhood Only (Not Street Legal)- Parking for 1 Vehicle- Located In The WaterSound Community- Private Gate Entrance to Neighborhood- Located Steps Away from the Pool and Beach- 3 Minute Drive to The Big Chill 30A- 13 Minute Drive to Seaside DETAILS:Welcome to Sea View at Compass Point II in WaterSound, where the beauty of a beach house meets the ease and amenities of a luxury condo. This stunning Gulf-front retreat offers three bedrooms, a bunk area, and breathtaking views of the coast and community pool—a perfect setting for a 30A getaway. On the first floor, unwind in the master suite with its private bath, walk-in shower, and soaking tub. There’s also a cozy bunk area with twin beds. Head upstairs to the open second-floor living space, where the kitchen, dining, and living areas create an inviting spot for entertaining with views of the coastal dune lake and sand dunes. This level also features a king guest bedroom with an en-suite bath. The third guest room—a bunk room with twin-over-full beds and a trundle—is perfect for kids or teens. Sea View’s resort amenities include nature trails, community pools, and easy access to the beach via a scenic boardwalk across the sand dunes. With four adult cruiser bikes and a 4-passenger golf cart, exploring WaterSound is a breeze. Offering ocean views, endless amenities, and serene coastal charm, Sea View is ready to make your next 30A getaway unforgettable. Start planning today! FIRST FLOOR:- Master Bedroom: King Bed (2), Private Bathroom with Soaking Tub and Walk In Shower- Bunk Room: Twin Over Twin Bunk Bed (2) SECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed (2), Private Bathroom With Walk-In Shower- Guest Bedroom: Twin Over Full Bunk Bed with Twin Trundle (4), Private Bathroom with Shower/ Tub Combo- Living Room- Kitchen - Half Bath- Laundry Room
rooms_guidance: Second Floor Guest Bedroom | 1 Twin Single, 1 Bunk Bed
